sources.excerpt: Did you know that the Great Wall of China is the only man-made structure visible

reasoning: The claim that the Great Wall of China is the only man-made structure visible from space with the naked eye is a well-documented myth. In reality, the Great Wall is generally not visible to the naked eye from low Earth orbit (and definitely not from the Moon) because it is narrow (only 6 to 9 meters wide) and constructed from materials that blend in with the surrounding natural terrain. Astronauts, including China's own Yang Liwei, have confirmed they could not see the Great Wall with the naked eye. Conversely, other large man-made structures—such as major highways, airports, dams, and the lights of large metropolitan areas at night—are readily visible to the naked eye from low Earth orbit.
